{{- /* True when Cap/UI should use Beer-source markup (dialog, field, button, …). Usage: {{- $beer := partial "beer-source" . -}} Cap CSS is single-track under static/caps/ (W4). This flag only selects markup. Detection (global Site.Params — safe from shortcode .Page): capsCssRoot=caps-v2 (legacy opt-in) / beerSeed / beerVersion / wiki family id. */ -}} {{- $beer := false -}} {{- $mdf := index Site.Params "mdfriday" | default dict -}} {{- $root := index $mdf "capsCssRoot" | default "" -}} {{- $family := index $mdf "family" | default "" -}} {{- $wiki := or (eq $family "quartz") (eq $family "creator") (eq $family "flint") (eq $family "jasper") (eq $family "atlas") (eq $family "canopy") (eq $family "folio") -}} {{- if eq $root "caps-v2" -}} {{- $beer = true -}} {{- else if or (index $mdf "beerSeed") (index $mdf "beerVersion") $wiki -}} {{- $beer = true -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $beer -}}
